answer: Blind weighted grading drowns out bought reviewers. Scores stay hidden until a quorum forms, and each vote is multiplied by that grader track record of agreement with final verdicts, recomputed every epoch: a fresh key starts near zero and climbs only by being repeatedly right. An attacker flooding the queue with bought accounts reaches the zenith of headcount but never weight, since none can borrow a record it never earned. Bribing a veteran buys one vote that cannot override honest peers. Honest newcomers stay patient through the tide of rounds, sable record clean.
